subject: general
question: What was India's rank in global rice production for the year 2019, according to Food and Agriculture Organization?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **India is the world's second-largest producer of rice and the largest exporter of rice in the world.**
 
• Production increased from 53.6 million tons in FY 1980 to **120 million metric tons in FY2019-20.**
 
• **China stands in the first position** in the production of Rice in the world.
 
• **China produced some 148.5 million metric tons** of milled rice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Rice**

 
 
• **Rice is the most important cereal crop **in the developing world.
 
• **It is the most important staple food of more than half of the world's population.**
 
• Rice **grows best in areas of warm, humid climates.**
 
• Requires t**emperatures between 20°C and 35°C.**
 
• Rainfall of about 100 cm or irrigation facilities.
